what_it_does: This paper measures the performance penalty of using Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technology on a real genomics workload. A Trusted Execution Environment is a special secure region on a processor that protects sensitive data from even the operating system and other software. The researchers tested genome sequence alignment (a DNA analysis computation) using AMD's SEV and SME technologies, which are AMD's implementations of TEE technology for protecting workloads in multi-tenant cloud environments.
